goal: Create scripts/story_film.py with parse_story(path) and tests/test_story_film.py with one unittest that exercises it.
requirements: parse_story(path) reads the UTF-8 markdown file at path and returns a list[str] of sentences.
Drop any line that is only a bracketed stage direction, such as **[Opening shot: ...]** or [...].
Remove the ** and * markers, and the double quote characters at the start and end of each quoted line.
Join the remaining text with single spaces, split after each . ! or ? that is followed by a space or the end of the text, strip each sentence and drop empty ones.
The test writes a temporary file with one stage direction line and one quoted line holding two sentences, and asserts parse_story returns exactly those two sentences.
context: Standard library only. The test imports with from scripts.story_film import parse_story and runs from the repo root. Do not change any other file.
